skills.name: sl-overall-review
skills.description: Interactively pick a base branch, pick a review profile (universal/bug-fix/feature/refactor/research/performance/security/migration/algorithm/messaging/docs), and run the matching reviewers in parallel against the diff. Outputs the findings as per-finding blocks.

skills.name: sl-gitlab-review-comments
skills.description: Add /sl-overall-review findings to a GitLab merge request as pending draft review notes (you submit them yourself in GitLab), inline on the diff, phrased in a suggestive register, with preview/confirm, per-run selection of findings (by number and/or severity), idempotent re-runs, and general-note fallback for lines outside the diff.

skills.name: sl-deepen-architecture
skills.description: Study the resting codebase and propose up to 3–4 high-leverage architecture improvements grounded in deep-module design (locality & leverage); rank by strength and deliver them either as a self-contained HTML proposal report (Files / Problem / Solution / Benefits / Before-After SVG / strength badge) saved to .skillsland/deepen-architecture/, or as plain text with ASCII diagrams in the chat. Read-only on code — proposes, does not implement.
